title: Volume Build — Squats, Hinges, and a New Finisher
intro: Week 2 of the fall block turns the effort up one notch: same seven days as ever, one more rep on the main lifts, and a brand-new Friday finisher. Every lift still has a barbell and a dumbbell path — pick your lane and log what you actually did.
coachNotes: Week 1 set your baselines; this week adds reps at the same loads. Only add weight when every set of a lift finishes with two clean reps in reserve.
The new Friday finisher caps out at eight minutes. It should feel like hard cardio, not a second lifting session.
If Wednesday's deadlifts felt heavy last week, keep the same weight and earn the extra rep before reaching for another plate.

days.structure: Warm-up 5 min · Straight sets · Cooldown 5 min

exercises.name: Back squat / Goblet squat
exercises.note: Same weight as last week, one rep more per set. Depth before load.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift / Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.note: Stop at the stretch your hamstrings control — no bouncing off the bottom.

days.structure: Warm-up 5 min · Straight sets · Cooldown 5 min

exercises.name: Bench press / Dumbbell bench press
exercises.note: Touch, pause, drive. The pause is one second — long enough to own the bottom.

days.focus: 25–40 minute walk + 5 minutes of hip, ankle, and shoulder mobility

days.structure: Warm-up 5 min · Straight sets · Cooldown 5 min

exercises.name: Deadlift / Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.note: Full reset every rep. Five singles strung together, not one twenty-rep grind.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust / Dumbbell hip thrust

days.structure: Warm-up 5 min · Straight sets, then the finisher · Cooldown 5 min

exercises.name: Push press / Dumbbell thruster
exercises.note: Legs throw the weight; arms just steer it.

exercises.name: New finisher — swing and step ladder
exercises.note: This week's fresh piece. Hard but repeatable — you should finish wanting one more round.

days.focus: Easy 30-minute walk, hike, or bike ride
Full rest. Sleep in, eat well, and let the week settle.
